title: Morgan Reyes
about: I'm currently the Global Talent Partner at Ivo, where I joined as their Founding Recruiter and scaled the team from 4 to 150 employees.
Before this, I studied Human Development and Psychology at Harvard University, where I did three internships in recruiting and people operations — two of them at early-stage startups.

My love for recruiting started during undergrad, working at AIESEC — the world's largest youth-led nonprofit developing leadership through international opportunities — where I ran people operations (hiring, retention, training, development) for a cohort of 160 students. From there, I joined Intellemo, an AI-powered video creation platform for businesses, as their Founding Recruiter during my third year of undergrad.
I love creating [art, teams, startups]. Startups are special because you get to build the machine that makes beautiful things at scale possible in the first place.
interests: Longevity and the mind–body connection. I'm fascinated by how much of physical health actually starts as a mental or emotional pattern.
Education, especially in early development [ages 0-14] where many critical behaviors are solidifed.
I like learning new things, especially from people who see beauty in their subject. I am interested in learning about everything important to anything [with priority on the highest leverage ideas].
People analytics, used carefully — attrition and engagement data can tell real stories, but they lie easily if you let them.
The parts of company culture that get built by accident versus the parts anyone actually designed on purpose.
